_help: Group name -> { flags, immunity, overrides }. flags: SM letters ("bcdefg") or names (["kick","ban"]); immunity: integer; overrides: { command: flag | "" for anyone }. Letters: a=reservation b=generic c=kick d=ban e=unban f=slay g=changemap h=convars i=config j=chat k=vote l=password m=rcon n=cheats z=root, o-t=custom1-custom6 (server-defined). e.g. "Full Admins": { "flags": "bcdefgjk", "immunity": 50 }
